# Pixel Quest

> A retro pixel-art habit tracker for Android. Add quests, earn XP, keep streaks, and climb from Novice to Mythic.

Pixel Quest is a gamified habit tracker. It features offline-first storage, an RPG-style quest system, seven progression tiers, and no tracking.

## Features
- Quests (Habits)
- XP & Levels
- Streaks & Streak Freezes
- Offline-first sync
- Local reminders
